_comment: Two clauses, two wrong effects. "As an additional cost, discard a PHOENIX FLAME": the DISCARD_CARD cost read only type_filter/class_filter, so a cost naming the card BY NAME had no filter at all -- the discard became RANDOM, and can_pay said yes whenever the hand held anything, making the card playable when its cost could not be paid. "Draconic ATTACK ACTION CARDS you control get +1{p} THIS TURN" was MODIFY_ATTACK_POWER_PER_UNIQUE_AURA, which counts distinct AURA NAMES in the arena, filtered on cards in hand -- a different effect measuring a different thing. MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN is the turn-scoped, per-attack-filtered modifier this needs; it is re-applied to every matching attack rather than consumed by the first. Draconic is a TALENT, not a class -- this card's own class is NotClassed.
